name: Pixerate paint
description: A glowing neon ribbon along the pointer's path, solid at its head and breaking apart towards its tail into glowing square pixels that scatter, drift and twinkle.

name: Swash text
description: A title with a glossy gradient ribbon swashing through it: in under the letters along the baseline, a loop over them, then an arc hooking over the end, rounded and twisting, shedding star sparkles, then eroding into frost.

name: Ribbon curl
description: A translucent gradient swash woven through what changed: a thin tail runs under the letters, loops over them and swells into an arc that hooks over the end of the word, shedding sparkles, then dissolves into frost. It is drawn only once the edit has landed; while the word is typed there is just a tint.

name: Design frame
description: A design tool's selection: a thin box with square corner handles tracing round what is checked and selected, and the box lingering round what changed before it fades.

name: Presence
description: A collaborator's presence, as in a shared document: a caret with a coloured name tag, an outline pulsing round what is being checked, and a selection and change tint in the collaborator's colour.

name: Scan line
description: A bright scanning line with a fading trail passing over the words being checked, a scanned selection, and a final pass over what changed.

name: Shimmer
description: A loading skeleton: the words sit on rounded pills while a bright glint streaks across them twice as they are checked, a pill selection, and a last glint across what changed.

name: Glow underline
description: A glowing underline sweeping on beneath the words being checked and wiping away from its tail, a lit underline under the selection, and a glowing caret.

name: Marker swipe
description: A highlighter pen swiping behind the words: a light pass while checking, a firm swipe over the selection, and a fresh stroke on what changed that dries away.

name: Soft sweep
description: A soft gradient sweeping across the word being checked, a selection growing over it in the agent's colour, the new word typed over the old with the caret at its end, then a tint on what changed that fades.

name: Word to icons
description: A word typed beside a small 'New in' chip, its letters shrinking away one after another as a row of coloured outline icons pops in where it stood, then popping out.

controls.l: Icons (document, slides, table, palette, chart, shapes, list)

name: Sheet fill
description: A spreadsheet filling itself in: a selection ring steps down two columns as each value types into its cell, then a difference column fills top to bottom in green or red by sign, and a collaborator's ring and name tag settle on the last cell.

name: Sticky board
description: A dotted whiteboard where a hand-drawn road winds across from left to right behind a collaborator's cursor, sticky notes popping up at each stop with a day pill on the road, as the view pulls back from the first note to the whole plan.

name: Logo cloud
description: App tiles scattered in depth round a central hub, the near ones big and soft, the far ones small, each layer drifting toward the viewer at its own pace before every tile flies into the hub and it pulses: integrations, connectors or partners.

name: Selection frame
description: Two lines of a headline swinging in at a tilt, each caught in a design tool's selection box with corner handles and a collaborator's name tag, then straightening with a little overshoot before the boxes let go.

name: Presence cursors
description: A headline with collaborators' cursors drifting round it, each with a coloured name tag; one cursor drags a selection across the first word and types a new one in its place, up to twice, the rest of the line sliding to make room.

name: Network bloom
description: A knowledge graph branching into being: a gold hub flares, cold blue comets shoot out along its spokes and land as pink nodes in a flash, each throwing out smaller comets that land as leaves, and the spokes warm from blue to gold as the graph settles; it holds, fades and blooms again, an intro for the live network.

name: Metric strip
description: A dashboard strip of up to four labelled metrics that counts up and then keeps ticking from one set of values to the next, a small green or red arrow showing which way each number moved and a light sweeping along the strip at every change.

name: Branch menu
description: A glowing orb reaching out to a stack of category tiles: curves draw out one after another with a spark running along each, every tile flashing bright as its spark lands and settling as its count ticks up, then the chosen one lights up in gold with its curve.

name: Colour blocks
description: Bands of flat colour sweep across in staggered rows, covering one picture and uncovering the next behind them. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.
